name: ZEN-NOH International Hong Kong Food Kwai Chung Factory
operator: ZEN-NOH International Hong Kong Food Limited

sources.evidence: The Hong Kong SAR Government reports that the Kwai Chung food factory opened on 17 March 2023, occupies 4,000 square feet and produces processed egg products including grilled eggs, hot spring eggs, steamed egg custard and egg sandwiches.
sources.publisher: Government of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

sources.evidence: ZEN-NOH's official global network lists ZEN-NOH International Hong Kong Food Limited at Unit 814, Vanta Industrial Centre, Kwai Chung, Hong Kong.
